subject: Audit playbook and evidence packet request for procurement RFP
messages:
From: Emily Sanders <emily.sanders@greenlightbank.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@greenlightbank.com, audit@mavenaudit.com
Date: 2027-05-30 09:12 AM PT
Subject: Request: audit playbook + control evidence for procurement RFP

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the quick call earlier. Greenlight is running an expedited procurement RFP for a new inference platform and our security team has asked for an "assurance playbook" and control evidence packet to accompany our vendor review. Can you please provide the following by June 6: 

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period)
- ISO 27001 certificate and scope statement
- A control-by-control mapping against the SIG questionnaire (we'll attach the control list)
- Evidence for the following control families: key management, backup & restore, privileged access reviews, incident detection/response (sample logs), and change control records

We have an external assessor (MavenAudit) participating and they'll want to see artifacts for sampling. If there are any items you cannot provide due to third-party NDAs or technical constraints, flag them and include an explanation.

Also please let me know if a short walkthrough of the key rotation and backup process is possible — the security lead wants to understand how proofs (e.g., KMS rotation logs, key custody) are produced.

Thanks,
Emily Sanders
Sr. Procurement Manager
Greenlight Bank

[Attachment: Greenlight_RFP_Control_List.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30 10:03 AM PT
Subject: Fwd: Request: audit playbook + control evidence for procurement RFP

Team — forwarding Greenlight's request (see attachment). They want a quick evidence packet by 2027-06-06. Marissa can you lead the mapping and artifact sign-off? Karthik, can you pull the technical artifacts (rotation logs, KV cache snapshots, backup manifests) and confirm what can be redacted? Neha, can you coordinate the alignment call and confirm logistics for handing larger artifacts to their assessor?

Key constraints to call out up front: our SOC2 and ISO artifacts are ready, but some supplier attestations (third-party backup provider) require us to request consent and may take longer. If we can't produce a particular artifact by 6/6, we should provide a compensating control explanation.

Proposed owner breakdown: 
- Marissa: control mapping + evidence acceptance
- Karthik: technical artifacts & redaction
- Neha: logistics, HubSpot updates, and external scheduling

Please confirm and note any blockers by EOD.

Aditya Rao
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Greenlight_RFP_Control_List.xlsx (xlsx) — forwarded]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30 11:20 AM PT
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: audit playbook + control evidence for procurement RFP

Thanks Aditya — I can own the mapping and acceptance criteria. Quick notes after a first pass on the control list: 

- SOC 2 Type II (2026) and ISO 27001 cert are available for distribution.
- Several artifacts (key rotation logs, backup manifests) exist but will need redaction of tenant-specific identifiers. We should produce redacted excerpts and an unredacted set under a secure transfer to MavenAudit only.
- Vendor attestations for our managed backup vendor will need a separate request; I estimate 7–10 business days for vendor-supplied evidence.

Ask to Karthik: I need sample rotation logs showing a full rotation event and the associated KMS audit record (one event each from primary and secondary region). Also provide a short POSIX-like dump of backup manifests for a single week (no sensitive payload).

Logistical ask to Neha: please set a 30-min alignment call with Greenlight + MavenAudit in the next 48 hours so we can triage must-have vs nice-to-have controls.

I'll start the control mapping in the attached template and mark critical vs optional items.

Marissa Cole
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: control_mapping_template.csv (csv)]

From: Emily Sanders <emily.sanders@greenlightbank.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@greenlightbank.com, audit@mavenaudit.com
Date: 2027-05-30 12:05 PM PT
Subject: Re: Request: audit playbook + control evidence for procurement RFP

Thanks, everyone — appreciate the quick response.

To clarify for the alignment call: the following are must-have items for Greenlight's short list (everything else is nice-to-have):
1) SOC 2 Type II report (full report + auditor opinion)
2) Evidence of KMS key rotation (rotation event + audit trail)
3) Backup manifest + proof of restore process (sample runbook + a restore verification log)
4) Privileged access review evidence (sample attestation cycle)

A short walkthrough of the key rotation process and where rotation logs are retained would be helpful on the call.

We can do the alignment call on Tuesday, June 1 at 10:00 AM PT if that works for your team.

Emily Sanders
Sr. Procurement Manager
Greenlight Bank

On May 30, 2027, at 10:03 AM, aditya_rao@redwood.com wrote:
> Team — forwarding Greenlight's request (see attachment). They want a quick evidence packet by 2027-06-06. Marissa can you lead the mapping and artifact sign-off?

[Attachment: Greenlight_MustHave_Controls.txt (txt)]

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: Emily Sanders <emily.sanders@greenlightbank.com>, procurement@greenlightbank.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, audit@mavenaudit.com
Date: 2027-06-01 11:35 AM PT
Subject: Re: Request: audit playbook + control evidence for procurement RFP — alignment call notes

Hi Emily — thanks for the call this morning. Summary and next steps: 

1) Deliverables by EOD 2027-06-04 (initial packet): SOC2 Type II (redacted), ISO 27001 cert, control mapping spreadsheet (redwood responses), redacted key rotation log sample, backup manifest excerpts, and privileged access review sample. 
2) Items requiring additional vendor consent: full vendor attestations for backup provider — estimated 7–10 business days. We will provide a compensating control description in the initial packet.
3) Security walkthrough: Marissa will do a 20-minute recorded demo focused on key rotation flow and where audit logs live; follow-up Q&A with MavenAudit as needed.
4) Secure delivery: Neha will organize a secure transfer to the Drive link below with access granted to procurement@greenlightbank.com and audit@mavenaudit.com only.

Action owners: 
- Marissa: produce mapping + recorded demo + redacted artifacts (due 6/4)
- Karthik: collect rotation logs and backup manifests, prepare redactions (due 6/3)
- Neha: set up drive permissions and HubSpot update (due 6/2)

Secure drive (private): https://drive.redwood.com/secure/greenlight-rfp-packet

Aditya Rao
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: SOC2_TypeII_Redwood_2026.pdf (pdf) — redacted copy to go to drive]

From: Emily Sanders <emily.sanders@greenlightbank.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@greenlightbank.com, audit@mavenaudit.com
Date: 2027-06-02 03:42 PM PT
Subject: Re: Request: audit playbook + control evidence for procurement RFP — initial packet receipt

Aditya / team,

We received the initial packet on the secure drive — thanks, especially for the timely redacted rotation logs and the SOC2 excerpt. MavenAudit will review the materials this week and let us know if they need unredacted access for sampling.

A couple of quick asks before the formal evaluation: 
- Can we schedule a 30-minute live demo of the key rotation flow and where rotation audit records are produced? Proposed: June 4, 10:00 AM PT.
- For backup verification, we'd like to see a restore verification log from a non-production snapshot (no data included) — if you can include that in the next update, that would be great.

If you can confirm the demo slot and approximate duration for the additional backup artifact delivery, we'll lock the next steps.

Thanks,
Emily Sanders
Sr. Procurement Manager
Greenlight Bank

[Attachment: Ack_receipt_Greenlight.pdf (pdf)]
